definition.r2: exp002 definition: 1 - SSE/SST on the pooled episodes of the role, SST about the role mean of the label (probe-seed mean of per-seed values)
definition.persistence: encoder tokens of the context frame t (t = num_hist - 1 = 0) copied to every step; the Q1 probe applied to the copy; label of step k = label of frame t+k
definition.ceiling: same probe on the encoder tokens of frame t+k
definition.untrained: predictor (and action/proprio encoders in variant pred_and_action_proprio) freshly initialised, see README section 3; DINOv2 input encoder is the original frozen one
definition.ci: episode-cluster bootstrap 95% (levels fixed), evaluation episodes only; excludes training-seed and untrained-seed variation

note_first_frame: num_hist = 1, so the last context frame is frame 0 = the first frame; both persistence definitions are the same set of predictions
